title: Wave 4 V4 Policy Encoder — Machine-Checkable Lint For App Plugin Consistency
description: Encode the machine-checkable subset of Wave 4 V1 (duplication hunter), V2 (structure auditor), V3 (coupling auditor) findings as a permanent `policy` export on root /Users/ueli/Documents/semio/script.ts, matching the repo's established `defineLint`/nx-plugin.mjs `breach-<slug>` convention. Then fix every genuine should-fix/blocking violation that is safe to fix mechanically (region marker formatting, missing region label, struct-name mismatch, unmigrated selection_ids duplicates), leaving SDK-primitive-gap items (Labels two-axis resolver, puzzle icon-based tree_item_with_action) as explicit allowlisted/tracked findings rather than false-positive failures.
summary: Added a permanent `policy` export to root script.ts encoding the machine-checkable subset of Wave 4 V1/V2/V3 findings (region-marker format incl. 🧪️Tests naming, one-🔖️Manifest-region-per-app, struct-name==PascalCase(id)+App, multi-app pub-mod isolation, no stray Cargo.lock/target, SDK-delegation checks for selection_ids/new_app/new_app_with_registry/meta/tree_item_with_action, hand-rolled Labels-struct detection, and app-to-app Cargo dependency-graph coupling), wired via the existing defineLint/nx-plugin.mjs convention (`bun ./📜️script.ts policy`, entity resolves to the "compose" technology). Fixed a pre-existing bug in repo/lib/js/index.ts's resolvePolicyScriptEntity that made workspace-root-level policy scripts unresolvable (falsy-empty-string id check, and technology root being echoed as an absolute path rather than "."). Directly fixed 6 genuine mechanical violations: fem's whole-file "// #region" -> "//#region" spacing plus its 🔖️Tests->🧪️Tests rename, framework's missing 🔖️RefreshUi endregion label, architect's ArchitectPlayApp->ArchitectApp struct rename (id "architect" mismatch), and procedural/puzzle's hand-rolled selection_ids duplicates now delegating to semio_framework_plugin::selection_ids first. Iteratively fixed 6 false-positive bugs surfaced while dogfooding the new lint against the live repo (cross-line lifetime-apostrophe corrupting brace-counted function-body extraction, a message-text bug, App::builder calls inside #[cfg(test)] fixtures being misread as real app manifests, an overly-broad tree_item_* delegation requirement, a too-short doc-comment lookback window for the Labels-struct check, and missing turbofish/import-alias tolerance in the SDK-delegate checks). Final `bun ./📜️script.ts policy` run completes cleanly and reports 30 genuine breaches (12 high/18 medium+low, incl. 4 explicitly allowlisted low-priority tracked SDK-gap findings for cad/puzzle Labels and puzzle d3/d5 tree_item_with_action) — some pre-date this ticket (fem mod-layout, s Manifest regions — both exactly matching V2) and some are new findings the permanent lint surfaces beyond V1/V2/V3's original audited-crate scope (framework's own bare-word region markers; animate/infinite-dag's un-migrated selection_ids/testkit/tree_item/Labels duplicates), left unfixed and explicitly reported rather than silently fixed or hidden, per instructions. cargo check on the 5 touched Rust crates was started but never completed within a bounded window (stuck on a build lock from unrelated concurrent sessions per known repo issue); validated instead via brace-balance sanity checks and by mirroring already-compiling sibling code shapes (procedural::app_3d, reasoning/mindmap) exactly.
